info.name: School Management System Midterm
info.description: Run once against an empty school_management_system database. Seed and test requests use API endpoints only. D1 past-date validation remains enabled; two exams are created on a valid date, transitioned, then their date is updated through PUT to satisfy the paper seed scenario.

item.name: Seed - move first pair to paper date
Seed - move marked pair to paper date

exec: pm.sendRequest({url: pm.collectionVariables.get("baseUrl") + "/api/subjects/all", method: "GET"}, function (err, response) { pm.test("Capture crudSubjectId", function () { pm.expect(err).to.equal(null); pm.expect(response.code).to.equal(200); const record = response.json().find(item => item.name === "Postman CRUD subject"); pm.expect(record, "record exists").to.exist; pm.collectionVariables.set("crudSubjectId", record.id); }); });

pm.sendRequest({url: pm.collectionVariables.get("baseUrl") + "/api/teachers/all", method: "GET"}, function (err, response) { pm.test("Capture crudTeacherId", function () { pm.expect(err).to.equal(null); pm.expect(response.code).to.equal(200); const record = response.json().find(item => item.email === "postman.crud.teacher@example.com"); pm.expect(record, "record exists").to.exist; pm.collectionVariables.set("crudTeacherId", record.id); }); });

pm.sendRequest({url: pm.collectionVariables.get("baseUrl") + "/api/students/all", method: "GET"}, function (err, response) { pm.test("Capture crudStudentId", function () { pm.expect(err).to.equal(null); pm.expect(response.code).to.equal(200); const record = response.json().find(item => item.regNumber === "POSTMAN-CRUD-001"); pm.expect(record, "record exists").to.exist; pm.collectionVariables.set("crudStudentId", record.id); }); });

pm.sendRequest({url: pm.collectionVariables.get("baseUrl") + "/api/exams/all", method: "GET"}, function (err, response) { pm.test("Capture crudExamId", function () { pm.expect(err).to.equal(null); pm.expect(response.code).to.equal(200); const exam = response.json().find(item => item.title === "Postman CRUD exam"); pm.expect(exam, "CRUD exam exists").to.exist; pm.collectionVariables.set("crudExamId", exam.id); }); });
pm.test("Exact status message", function () { pm.response.to.have.body("Exam status updated successfully"); });
pm.test("Exact status message", function () { pm.response.to.have.body("Exam status updated successfully"); });
pm.test("Two required Iradukunda students returned", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().length).to.be.at.least(2); });
pm.test("Room 4 is free before D4", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().some(c => c.roomNumber === 4)).to.equal(true); });
pm.test("Kinyarwanda is unused", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().some(s => s.name === "Kinyarwanda")).to.equal(true); });

item.name: D1 - Save future exam (status forced PLANNED)

exec: pm.sendRequest({url: pm.collectionVariables.get("baseUrl") + "/api/exams/all", method: "GET"}, function (err, response) { pm.test("Capture businessExamId", function () { pm.expect(err).to.equal(null); pm.expect(response.code).to.equal(200); const record = response.json().find(item => item.title === "Postman D1 safe save"); pm.expect(record, "record exists").to.exist; pm.collectionVariables.set("businessExamId", record.id); }); });
pm.test("Exact past-date message", function () { pm.response.to.have.body("Exam date cannot be in the past"); });
pm.test("Exact duplicate message", function () { pm.response.to.have.body("Teacher already supervises an exam on that date"); });
pm.test("Exact status message", function () { pm.response.to.have.body("Exam status updated successfully"); });
pm.test("Exact transition message", function () { pm.response.to.have.body("Cannot change status from MARKED to PLANNED"); });
pm.test("Exact add-subject message", function () { pm.response.to.have.body("Subject added to the teacher"); });
pm.test("Exact duplicate-subject message", function () { pm.response.to.have.body("The teacher already has that subject"); });

item.name: E1 - Save grade for marked exam

exec: pm.sendRequest({url: pm.collectionVariables.get("baseUrl") + "/api/grades/student/S4-2026-018", method: "GET"}, function (err, response) { pm.test("Capture gradeId", function () { pm.expect(err).to.equal(null); pm.expect(response.code).to.equal(200); const grade = response.json().find(item => item.comment === pm.collectionVariables.get("gradeTestComment")); pm.expect(grade, "saved grade exists").to.exist; pm.collectionVariables.set("gradeId", grade.id); }); });

item.name: E1 - Reject grade for unmarked exam

exec: pm.test("Exact unmarked-grade message", function () { pm.response.to.have.body("Grades are only for MARKED exams"); });
pm.test("Grade history contains saved grade", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().some(item => item.id === pm.collectionVariables.get("gradeId"))).to.equal(true); });
pm.test("Exact grade protection message", function () { pm.response.to.have.body("That exam has grades, delete them first"); });

item.name: E3 - Delete exam after grade deletion

exec: pm.test("Only the non-marked exam was updated", function () { pm.response.to.have.body("1 exams cancelled"); });

pm.test("Dashboard fields returned", function () { const d = pm.response.json(); ["students","teachers","freeClassrooms","examsToday","planned","grades"].forEach(k => pm.expect(d).to.have.property(k)); });
pm.test("Page metadata returned", function () { const p = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(p).to.have.property("totalPages"); pm.expect(p).to.have.property("totalElements"); });
